borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
description: Non-material amendment to planning permission ref: 2022/00721/VAR granted 24th April 2023 for the 'Variation of condition 2 and 48 of planning permission ref: 2019/01416/VAR granted 26th February 2021 for the Variation of condition 2 of planning permission ref: 2017/01242/FUL granted 8th August 2017 to 'allow amendments to the approved drawings to include: Extension of single storey basement; installation of a new fire door on east elevation and associated changes to the frontage at ground floor level, relocation of window from northern elevation to southern elevation at third floor level, new oriel windows replaced with flush windows on western elevation and alterations to oriel windows and vents on northern elevation, reduction of balustrading to terraces at third floor level and erection of a new brick boundary wall on western elevation.' Amendments sought include: relocation of commercial bin store from ground floor to basement level, relocation of condenser units to yard; courtyard mesh added to the delivery yard, inclusion of access ladders and a mansafe system, inclusion of additional glazing to the oriel windows on the North West elevation (Condition 2); and update to retail Use Class from Class A1 to Class E(a) (Condition 48)' to allow amendments to the approved (North-East Elevation: drawing number: 28906(P99)905H) and (Ground Floor General Arrangement Plan (drawing number. 28906(P30)002B) drawings to include: new inward opening fire door with sidelight to prevent clash with internal steel column, smoke outlet door with automated closer linked to fire alarm panel, smoke outlet pavement lights onto delivery yard and reconfiguration of air source heat pumps and air conditioning units within service yard.
